blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas secured a spot in the men’s U-23 3×3 basketball tournament at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games after dethroning Chinese Taipei, 21-19, on Thursday. Koji Buenaflor and Luis Pablo scored the go-ahead and winning baskets, respectively, as Gilas put itself in medal contention after a hard-fought win at Kinjo Futo Station Square. Buenaflor broke a 19-all tie, Gilas forced Chinese Taipei to a pair of two-pointers before Pablo drove inside to end the contest with 15.7 seconds remaining.
